question: Should all patients be optimized to the same preoperative hemoglobin level to avoid transfusion in primary knee arthroplasty?
reference_answer: No. Not all the patients undergoing TKA who receive tranexamic acid need the same preoperative Hb optimization target. Two easily available factors, such as the ASA score and the Hb level, can help individualize the Hb optimization target.
